generations.name: V1.0
generations.description: A single solar-array wing and flat spacecraft bus. Early and later batches differ; laser capability must not be inferred from this label alone.

generations.name: V1.5
generations.description: A later first-generation design associated with the expansion of inter-satellite optical links. Hardware generation is separate from orbital status.

generations.name: V2 Mini
generations.description: A larger bus and two solar-array wings. The Mini name distinguishes it from the much larger Starship-class design.

generations.name: V2 Mini Optimized
generations.description: GCAT distinguishes this hardware bus from the original Mini. The count here follows that classification, rather than grouping every Gen 2 satellite together.

generations.name: Direct to Cell
generations.description: These spacecraft add a cellular payload. A satellite overhead does not establish local mobile-service availability: partner, device and regulatory conditions still apply.

generations.name: V3
generations.description: Tracked separately in McDowell’s catalogue. Launched, in orbit, working and in an operational shell remain distinct milestones.
